notes.title: 📡 Control Broadcast. New Deployment Zone: Cult Ruins

Expect heavier anomaly presence and more intricate detection requirements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Key Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]biggest mission zone yet[/b] — larger layouts, more feeds, more Breaches[/p][/*][*][p]New Breaches woven into the cult’s desecrated environment[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty escalated — survival demands precision, vigilance, and endurance[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]This deployment is not recommended for untested agents.[/p][p]Proceed only if you are prepared to fail — repeatedly.[/p][p][/p][p]— [b]Control[/b][/p]

notes.title: 📡 Control Broadcast #412 – Portable Access Granted
notes.notes: [p][b]📡 Control Broadcast #412 – Portable Access Granted[/b][/p][quote][p][b]Attention Operatives,[/b][/p][p]Field deployment no longer requires the full observation terminal.[/p][p]The [b]System[/b] has successfully adapted Breach: 83 for [i]Portable Surveillance Units[/i] — civilian codename: “Steam Deck.”[/p][p]You may now monitor breaches, issue reports, and conduct containment procedures [b]from anywhere[/b]: the train, the couch, even within safe rooms (if you can find one).[/p][p][/p][p][b]Operational Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fully Control through either touchscreen or steam deck mapping pre-calibrated for PSU interface — no setup required[/p][/*][*][p]Visual feed reccomended at 1280x720 or 1920×1080 for optimal performance[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Note:[/b] This platform is pending [i]Official PSU Compliance Verification[/i]. Until then, your participation in field trials is crucial. Report any anomalies in performance directly to Control.[/p][p]Stay mobile, stay vigilant.[/p][p]— [b]Control[/b][/p][/quote]

notes.title: FIELD PROTOCOL UPDATE: VERSION 1.2 DEPLOYED
notes.notes: [p]As per revised breach-handling protocols, the Negligence Containment Division has released Patch 1.2, designed to assist Operatives struggling under the escalating hostility within Breach: 83.[/p][p]Key augmentations include:[/p][p][/p][h3]Difficulty Response Calibration[/h3][p] -Operatives may now unlock and select from multiple operational difficulty tiers. Whether you're a first-time initiate or a veteran of the Breach, there is now a setting aligned to your resilience threshold.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644065/54ecacfe2e8531727379b4e6303063f4f1f22fc5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Enhanced Report Protocol[/h3][p]-Object interaction protocols have received refinement. Operatives may now report Breaches with the aptly named "REPORT" button. Allowing Operatives to use their intuition rather than pinpointing exact Breach locations.[/p][p][/p][h3]Basic Controller Integration[/h3][p]-Operatives may now operate with Analog input devices. Analog precision will be fine tuned and improved in the next patch[/p][h3][/h3][h3]Small QOL adjustments[/h3][p]-Level timer added, Countdown timer when max Breaches limit reached added, Max Breaches increased from 5-7, countdown time when max Breaches reached doubled. [/p][p][/p][p]The Breach adapts... but so do we.[/p][p]Remember: Observation breeds survival. Adaptation ensures it.[/p][p]Operatives are advised to recalibrate their loadouts and test new control bindings before re-entering affected zones.[/p][p]Continue your work. We watch the watchers.[/p][p]— Control[/p][p][/p][p][i]*Dev addendum. Next Patch will focus on lighting. Current setup is optimised for HDR displays, Non HDR displays as a result appear gratuitously dark. Fixing this is my current priority. Also looking to add more interesting achievements and improve artwork shortly[/i][/p]

notes.title: ATTN: Operatives Assigned to BREACH : 83. Assistance Inbound
notes.notes:
[p]Due to a rising number of compromised operatives and incomplete assignments, the Negligence Containment Division has authorized the deployment of classified support protocols.[/p][p]If you are experiencing disorientation, prolonged cognitive interference, or inexplicable obstruction within any monitored location—[b]you are not alone.[/b][/p][p]A secure channel has been opened at:[/p][p][/p][p] 🔗 [url="https://www.rustycoggames.com/operativeassistance"]Operative Assistance Initiative[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Here, you will find authorized Pre-Breach Screenshots, operative notes, and Breach navigation guidance. Access is strictly voluntary, and use of this assistance will not disqualify you from commendation status.[/p][p][/p][quote][p]Sometimes, even the most vigilant watcher needs a light in the dark.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Proceed with caution.
Stay alert. Stay alive.
— [i]Control[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]-Additional. While Control takes no responsibitiy for any failures to date. There will be a number of unrelated improvements made to the system in the coming week. Namely Lighting improvement and Difficulty adjustment, with further plans of useable abilities to assist tracking the presence of Breaches.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience.[/p]
